headlines.title: Fresh wave of U.S. tariffs takes effect, hitting global trade partners
headlines.description: These new duties, which range from 10% to 12.5%, will take effect Friday morning, just as the previous tariffs expire.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak expands to 9 states
headlines.description: The massive, multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis has expanded to nine states, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday.

headlines.title: U.S. launches new strikes and Trump threatens ‘massive attack’ as Iran widens war
headlines.description: The United States launched a fresh barrage of strikes on Iran overnight as President Donald Trump threatened a major new escalation after Tehran opened a second front in its pressure campaign on the world economy.

headlines.title: How to Cut Wedding Costs Without Sacrificing Style
headlines.description: Looking to elevate the glam for your wedding without breaking the bank? Event planner Jove Meyer joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share his tips for getting luxury décor for less. Jove shares tips for saving on flower arrangements, wedding invitations and cakes, and recommends some of his favorite touches to make the big day memorable.

headlines.title: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve hits lowest level since 1983 while oil prices surge
headlines.description: Crude oil prices are back over $100 per barrel as the war in Iran escalates. This comes as the U.S. continues to deplete its Strategic Petroleum Reserve to 40-year lows, as it tries to buffer the economic impact of the war. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports.

headlines.title: How Your Credit Score Works (and How to Boost it)
headlines.description: Credit scores determine your interest rate on everything from auto loans to mortgages, so finance expert and host of the “So Money” podcast, Farnoosh Torabi, joins TODAY to break down everything you need to know. She explains what a credit score is, the most common mistakes, how to boost your score, and more. See her tips!

headlines.title: Which US Cities Are Hiring? LinkedIn Shares List of Best Places
headlines.description: LinkedIn editor-in-chief Dan Roth stops by TODAY to share an exclusive first look at its list of cities with the fastest job growth. Harrisburg, Pennsylvania comes in at No. 5 and Sarasota, Florida, at No. 4. See which cities nabbed the top 3 spots!

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Oil prices surge to $100 per barrel after Red Sea attacks
headlines.description: European and U.S. crude oil both jumped, hitting their highest levels in weeks.

headlines.title: Track U.S., state and county gas prices
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Oil surges past $95 as U.S. downplays Iran diplomacy and 2nd trade route is disrupted
headlines.description: The international benchmark Brent crude rose almost 5% to hit more than $95 per barrel for the first time in almost six weeks.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.
